# Block AI crawlers that scrape content to train foundation models. These never
# send a visitor to the site in return, unlike the "answer engine" bots below
# (ChatGPT-User, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, YouBot) that fetch pages live on
# behalf of an actual user's question and can cite/link back - those are
# intentionally left unblocked and fall through to the general crawler rules.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

# Common Crawl - scraped dataset reused by many AI companies for training
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

# Gemini/Vertex training only - separate from Google Search and AI Overviews
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

# Meta AI (Llama) training crawler
User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Disallow: /

# ByteDance/TikTok AI training crawlers
User-agent: ByteDance
Disallow: /

User-agent: ByteSpider
Disallow: /

# Apple Intelligence training opt-out - separate from Siri/Spotlight's regular Applebot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

# Allow Facebook link previews (needed for social sharing)
User-agent: FacebookBot
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /*.log$
Allow: /

User-agent: facebookexternalhit
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /*.log$
Allow: /

# Allow Baidu search but restrict to public content only
User-agent: Baiduspider
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /*.log$
Crawl-delay: 10

# General crawlers
User-agent: *
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /*.log$
Disallow: /*.php$

# These pages require being logged in, so anonymous crawlers only ever get a 401.
Disallow: /create-report
Disallow: /tab-submissions
Disallow: /reputation
Disallow: /reports
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /change-username
Disallow: /notifications
Disallow: /my-tabs
Disallow: /preparing-tab-file-download
Disallow: /global-stats
Disallow: /account-deactivation

# Every query-param combination is the same underlying page; crawl the bare URL instead.
Disallow: /tabs?*
Disallow: /login?*
Disallow: /create-account?*

# Retired URL shapes that nginx already answers with 410 Gone (see nginx.conf).
# Listed here too so crawlers stop requesting them at all instead of just
# getting told "gone" on every attempt.
Disallow: /administrator/
Disallow: /all-tabs/
Disallow: /article/
Disallow: /articles/
Disallow: /backend/
Disallow: /comment/
Disallow: /comments/
Disallow: /composer/
Disallow: /composers/
Disallow: /dashboard/
Disallow: /file/
Disallow: /files/
Disallow: /forum/topic/
Disallow: /game/
Disallow: /member/
Disallow: /members/
Disallow: /message/
Disallow: /messages/
Disallow: /module/
Disallow: /modules/
Disallow: /node/
Disallow: /nodes/
Disallow: /panel/
Disallow: /platform/
Disallow: /platforms/
Disallow: /recording/
Disallow: /recordings/
Disallow: /request/
Disallow: /requests/
Disallow: /series/
Disallow: /stat/
Disallow: /stats/
Disallow: /style/
Disallow: /styles/
Disallow: /template/
Disallow: /templates/
Disallow: /user/
Disallow: /users/

Crawl-delay: 5
Sitemap: https://gametabs.net/sitemap.xml
